title: Taylor says Bledsoe may need to hide out in Nassau

tellings.quote: He just told me at one point that that he thought I may have to go hide out there a while.

plain: In 2008 a man named Timothy Taylor told Chris Bledsoe that he might have to go hide out in Nassau, in the Bahamas, for a while. Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs keep appearing around him, tells Michels this himself, as something said to him directly. He tells it as a sign of how serious, and possibly dangerous, his situation had become.
